older.label: Older house
older.first: If the attic holds loose pebble-like flakes, treat it as asbestos: do not disturb it, store nothing up there, and read what to do before anyone works in it. Pre-1978: assume old paint layers contain lead and never dry-sand them.

water.label: Water
water.first: Find out what is in your water, then use a filter certified to NSF/ANSI 53 or 58 that names PFAS reduction — and check the certifier's own listing, not the box.
water.linkLabel: Is my water filter certified for PFAS?

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.first: Retire scratched nonstick for cast iron or stainless, and stop reheating food in plastic. Two changes, most of the kitchen's avoidable load.

living.label: Living & bedrooms
living.first: Stop fabric-protector sprays and skip 'stain-proof' textiles when you next buy; drop the plug-ins and daily candles. Dust is where these end up — damp-wipe, don't dry-sweep.

structure.label: Attic, structure & air
structure.first: Vent combustion (a hood that goes outside, or induction), test for radon once, and fix damp at the source before cleaning the mould.

cleaning.label: Laundry & cleaning
cleaning.first: Switch to fragrance-free basics and drop dryer sheets and softener. The cheapest cut in the house.
